text:
Mathew Barzal missed the start of the season with a knee injury and made his debut Nov. 14 in Anaheim. Six games in, he has a goal and four points, and the Islanders have already tried him in different spots. Yahoo Sports reported this week that Pete DeBoer reunited him with Bo Horvat and "it pays off for Islanders."

Six games is a tiny sample, so treat every number lightly. Still, the early signs are good: New York has taken 63.38% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at even strength with him on the ice, and he has 16 shots. His one goal on 2.18 expected is just a slow start. This is the player Evolving-Hockey had worth 2.8 wins last season, 20th among forwards, and whom Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had carrying the puck in on 66% of his entries. Our numbers project 48 points over the rest of the year. Watch his ice time, 24.5 minutes in his latest game, as he gets his legs back.
headline: Mathew Barzal is back, and back with Bo Horvat
